newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Receivers to start Fokker liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Receivers to start Fokker liquidation.

text.p: The receivers of bankrupt Dutch planemaker Fokker said on Tuesday they would begin liquidation of the company with sales of non-fixed assets.
Two Dutch firms will hold a series of private sales and auctions this autumn, the receivers said in a statement.
Fokker has been bankrupt for over a year. The last jet rolled off the production lines over a month ago.

Last month, a consortium of Chinese and Russian investors said they were able to launch a last ditch rescue bid, but receivers said it would take a miracle to save Fokker after a string of unsuccessful takeover talks.
